query:
UPDATE workspace_settings
        SET git_sync = jsonb_set(
            git_sync,
            '{repositories}',
            (SELECT jsonb_agg(
                CASE WHEN elem->>'git_repo_resource_path' IN ($2, '$res:' || $2)
                    THEN jsonb_set(
                            jsonb_set(elem, '{auto_pull}',
                                      COALESCE(elem->'auto_pull', '{"enabled": false}'::jsonb), true),
                            '{auto_pull,last_synced_sha}',
                            COALESCE(elem->'auto_pull'->'last_synced_sha', '{}'::jsonb)
                                || jsonb_build_object($3::text, $4::text),
                            true)
                    ELSE elem END)
             FROM jsonb_array_elements(git_sync->'repositories') AS elem)
        )
        WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND jsonb_typeof(git_sync->'repositories') = 'array'
